[[File:Rune plateskirt detail.png|120px|left]]
The '''rune plateskirt''' is a [[plateskirt]] made out of [[runite]]. It requires level 40 [[Defence]] to wear. The rune plateskirt is identical in function to [[rune platelegs]], but is 1 kg lighter.

It can be created with the [[Smithing]] [[skill]] by using 3 [[runite bar]]s and a [[hammer]] on an [[anvil]]; this requires level 99 Smithing and yields 225 Smithing [[experience]].

Characters may receive these from the [[crystal chest]].

Along with the [[rune 2h sword]] and [[Rune platelegs|platelegs]], this is the best [[bar]]-per-[[Alchemy spells|alch]] [[item]] in the game. If smithing for money, rune 2h sword, platelegs, and plateskirt will give the best value for each bar.
